# Competitor pricing snapshot (operator-supplied)

Auth0 has moved its B2B "Essentials" tier pricing upward again this year, and
several threads mention teams looking for predictable per-tenant pricing rather
than per-active-user billing.

Clerk positions heavily around frontend/React DX. Multiple posts note gaps in
fine-grained authorization and audit trails for regulated workloads.

A recurring theme: startups building autonomous AI agents want to constrain what
each agent can do (scopes, approvals, audit) and find raw API keys insufficient.
